questions.stem_text: The primary function of political action committees (PACs) is to

options.A: contribute money to candidates for election
options.C: promote the defeat of incumbents in the federal and state legislatures
options.D: organize protest demonstrations and other acts of civil disobedience

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - contribute money to candidates for election

questions.stem_text:
Which committee in the House of Representatives determines the procedure by which bills
are debated and amended?

The No Child Left Behind Act, which established educational standards that states must
meet to receive federal educational funding, is an example of which of the following?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A federal mandate

questions.stem_text: Why might the 'Philadelphian System' be linked to the idea of American exceptionalism?

options.A: It encouraged greater involvement in European politics
options.B: It was designed as the antithesis of European politics
options.C: It created a large standing army
options.D: It encouraged the centralization of political power in the US

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It was designed as the antithesis of European politics

questions.stem_text:
When considering economic tools for security policy, which of the following is the odd one
out?

options.A: Withdrawal of economic trade rights with the domestic market.
options.B: Export controls protecting technological advantage and further foreign policy objectives.
options.C: Control of munitions and arms sales.
options.D: Import restrictions to protect a domestic market from foreign goods.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Withdrawal of economic trade rights with the domestic market.
